Previous page

 1 PD Charging   2 Data Transfer   3 4K HDMI 





























1. Why does the iPad Pro series not display images?
Due to the tablet's image output mechanism, it needs to identify the USB3.0 device to output images. You can first connect the device to the USB3.0 port of the hub, and then connect the hub to the iPad Pro to display the image.
2. What happens when there is no HDMI image output after the product is connected?
1) Please make sure that the USB-C interface of the laptop supports the video function;
2) Please confirm whether the length and specifications of the connected cable meet the requirements, and whether the interface is firmly plugged;
3) Please adjust the resolution setting of the laptop, the resolution supported by your monitor may be lower than the highest supported resolution of the product;
4) Please select the correct input signal source (some monitors need to manually select the signal source);
5) You can try to restart the laptop, or re-plug the upstream end；
6) If possible, try a different monitor and laptop.

Please make sure your Android phone supports Android 9.0 or above.                                        2.                                    To ensure the pop-up appears correctly on your Android phone, please make sure your Google Play Services and Google Find Hub are updated to the latest versions.                                        3.                                     What should I do if the tracker still can't connect after the pop-up appears?                                                                             A. If you accidentally exit the pop-up screen after the pop-up appears, please wait for the next pop-up, or wait 5 minutes or restart your phone before the pop-up appears again.                                                                             B. Click "Close" after the pop-up appears. This will prevent the pop-up from appearing again. You will need to wait 5 minutes or restart your phone before the pop-up appears again.                                                                             C. On some phones, the pop-up may appear normally for a while but then suddenly stop. Even if waiting 5 minutes doesn't work, restarting the phone may restore the connection.                                        Quick Operation Guide                                    Power On: Press the button once to power on. You will hear four consecutive "di" prompts (power indicator flashes).                                                                             Shut Down: Double-press the button twice, then hold it for 5 seconds until you hear a "di" sound. Release to hear two "di" prompts, indicating successful shutdown. First-time Power On: Automatically shuts down after 5 minutes if no binding record exists.                                                                             Pairing: Android phones will receive a pop-up pairing prompt. Select "Pair," then follow instructions to click "Accept & Continue."                                                                             Successful Pairing: Continuous "di-di-di" prompts indicate successful connection.                                        Factory Reset:                                    1）Double-press the button twice to hear one "di" prompt. 2）Hold the button for 5 seconds until you hear a "di" every second. 3）Continue holding until two "di" prompts sound, then release.  4) "di" prompts confirm successful reset.                                        Incompatible Device List                                    Note: Due to the recent Google system update, some phones (Motorola Moto G Stylus 5G, Motorola Edge, TCL 30XL, TCL 30Z, Google Pixel 8) may experience temporary incompatibility. title: UGREEN 69W USB C Car Charger
description:
Q1: Why does it sometimes wake up my device when I plug in or unplug another device ?
When multiple devices are connected at the same time, plugging a new device in or unplugging any of the devices from the charger will render a short charging pause for other devices. This short pause is due to the power redistribution of the charger.
Q2: Why is there a situation of disconnection when I charge my Apple watches with port A?
Generally, we suggest you use the USB C port to charge Apple watch. If you want to to use the USB A port, only the C1 and A port can be used simultaneously under the circumstances.
